Ruling: batch #147 item 2 · letter 停放 (parked; the design discussed with the maintainer is recorded here so the restart starts from it) · maintainer 「18164 停放」 2026-09-17T14:09Z

Director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`. Presented in detail; the maintainer first said 「这是非常具体的业务需求,主流平台应该都支持吧,这个应该要开发。你可以和我讨论具体的方案」, the seat laid out a design, and the maintainer then ruled 「18164 停放」 under 「创业期现在不追求功能多,追求稳定」. Under the corrected need standard (5715688324) the need is real (Salesforce Global Value Sets, Dataverse global option sets); the park is a **sequencing** decision, ⛔ not a judgement that the need is absent.

## Ruling — **停放**

- `needs-user-decision` → `pm:on-hold`. **Restart-when** (body's leading line): a customer requirement needs a shared option list extended per organization without forking the app, or the maintainer schedules it after the current stability work (package split, `can`, spec narrowings) lands.
- Meanwhile the reference app keeps its TypeScript constants (`src/sales/objects/_picklists.ts`, spread at each use site) — a working, non-silent shape.

## Design recorded for the restart (discussed on the direct channel; ⛔ not ruled in detail — the three open points are the maintainer's)

1. New metadata kind **`picklist`** (name to confirm: `picklist` vs `valueSet`): `{ name, label, description?, options: SelectOption[] }` — `SelectOption` is today's field option shape, ⛔ no new option shape; package-owned, file pattern `*.picklist.ts`, registered before `object` in load order.
2. Field reference `Field.select({ picklist: 'industry' })`, mutually exclusive with `options`; both or neither on a select type is refused.
3. **Server-resolved**: field metadata served to clients carries the resolved `options`, so objectui's renderers, validation and filters are unchanged in phase 1; write validation uses the resolved set.
4. Extension and overlay are **additive only**: package-level `picklistExtensions: [{ extend, options }]` (the `objectExtensions` idiom); per-organization overlay of the same shape in `sys_metadata` with `allowOrgOverride: true` and an overlay schema that accepts new values only — removal/rename stays with the owning package (open point: allow the org overlay at all, or package-level extension only).
5. Translation: `TranslationData.picklists.<name>.{ label?, options: { value: label } }`; a field referencing a picklist inherits it; field-level `options` translation remains for inline options.
6. Verification (ADR-0136 D2.4): two `records-forms` checklist items + one dogfood case (one picklist, two objects, org A adds a value, A writes it, B is refused, locale switch relabels); hotcrm migrates its shared lists as the acceptance.
7. Phases: 1 = spec + engine + CLI compile + translation + hotcrm migration (Studio untouched); 2 = Studio picklist page and 「use picklist」 in the object designer. Not in v1: cascading picklists (per-option `visibleWhen` and `dependsOn` exist), unrestricted mode, per-record-type value restriction. Open point three: one-page ADR first vs. straight to a card.

Ruling: batch #209 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「18164 同意」 2026-09-21T05:05Z

Director seat, summon #25 (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`). Returned to the decision box at 5755100805 under the maintainer's 「还有哪些应该解除停放的你一起排查一下」/「同意」; presented in detail with the recommendation **A** (facet ①: every mature platform models a shared option list as first-class metadata — Salesforce Global Value Sets, Dataverse global option sets — and it retires the 「cross-package TypeScript constants」 special case; ② pull measured in the reference app: `_picklists.ts` ≈ 3,001 tokens, 17 consumers, three packages; ③ a named picklist makes an AI author's wrong reference a loud refusal where today's copied option lists drift silently; ④ a new declared kind is a permanent obligation, so the direction is set now and the schedule stays behind the open product P0/P1). The maintainer agreed. The 2026-09-17 park (batch #147 item 2, 5715762696) was a sequencing decision; its recorded design is the design of record and is carried into the sub-issues unchanged.

**Ruled: A.** The feature enters the road map and the queue at its road position — step ②「本地跑起来、看到」, records — as one cross-layer feature point: this card is the parent, three sub-issues carry the layers in `Blocked-by:` order, spec first:

1. **#19518** — spec (`domain:spec`, `pm:queue`, p2): the `picklist` kind, `Field.select({ picklist })` mutually exclusive with `options`, the server-resolved served shape, the translation face, the additive package-level `picklistExtensions` shape; with it the feature-map line in `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 「路上的功能点」 and the two `records-forms` checklist items (its own small Tier H docs PR).
2. **#19519** — runtime (`domain:engine`, `pm:blocked` → released when #19518 lands): load order, additive merge, resolve-at-serve, write validation against the resolved set; hotcrm's migration of its shared lists is filed as a hotcrm card by the epic PM when this lands.
3. **objectui#10202** — Studio (`domain:ui`, `pm:blocked` → released when #19519 is installable by pin): picklist page and 「use picklist」 in the object designer (phase 2; phase 1 needs no frontend change because options are served resolved).

Phase 2's per-organization overlay (ADR-0005, additive only) is deferred to its own sub-issue when a customer requirement measures it; the three sub-issues say so. ⛔ None of the three is dispatched before the open product P0/P1 checklist items — the road order decides, and the `domain:spec` seat takes #19518 when it reaches it. When work starts, an epic PM session takes this parent (`pm:epic` + session ID on the body per 〈Epic 子树车道〉); until then the parent carries `pm:queue` as a coordination node and is never dispatched itself.

四棱行:① A(成熟平台皆有,收掉跨包常量特例) · ② 自家实测、外部未测 · ③ A 响亮(命名引用写错即拒) · ④ 定方向不抢期(排在 P0/P1 之后)
Prior rulings read: picklist, global value set, valueSet → 2 hits (this card's batch #147 park; #18163 sibling); ADR-0005 (overlay), ADR-0136 D2.4 (verification); thread: none

**Execution, same stroke:** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` on this card; body's leading `Restart-when:` line replaced by the `Path:` line; the three sub-issues filed, labelled and linked as GitHub sub-issues of this card; `area:records` is added to the parent and the sub-issues once the `area:*` labels exist (created by `ensure-pm-labels.sh` after PR #19488 lands).

## 决策请求:「共享选项列表」这项功能，现在就开工 spec 层吗？它的元数据类型叫 `picklist` 还是 `valueSet`? · 2026-09-30T03:31Z

`domain:spec` seat 5(`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`)。本卡是父卡，一直以 `pm:queue` 充当协调节点;它的 spec 子卡是 #19518。本评论把两个一直没落卡的问题放进决策箱，本卡同时转入 `needs-user-decision`。
⚠️ 本席此前只在聊天里问过这两题，违反了「卡先于弹窗」。

### 一句话问题

- **Q1(时序):** 09-21 的裁决说这项功能排在所有未关闭的产品 P0/P1 之后;09-23 你又在本车道放开了「P0/P1 优先」这条规则。#19518 现在能不能开工?
- **Q2(命名):** 新的元数据类型要写进文件名、注册表、翻译结构和对外文档，一旦发布就改不了。它叫 `picklist` 还是 `valueSet`?

### Governing text

- 本卡裁决 `5755653853`(batch #209 item 1,字母 A,维护者「18164 同意」,2026-09-21):「⛔ None of the three is dispatched before the open product P0/P1 checklist items — the road order decides」。
- 维护者 2026-09-23 在本席会话中的「A」:本车道放开 NORTH-STAR 优先级第 3 条。
- #19518 正文 Scope 第 1 条:「name to confirm on the parent before the PR: `picklist` vs `valueSet`」。
- 设计底稿 `5715762696`(batch #147 item 2)第 1 条同样写着「name to confirm」。
- 协议声明：两题都不改现有协议。Q2 决定的是一个新元数据类型的公开名字。

### 前提(每条带复查方法)

1. **未关闭的产品 P0/P1 数量。** 本席 2026-09-30T03:31Z 用 REST 按标签列出:P0 2 张,P1 非 tooling 15 张;09-22 4 号席读数为 P0 4 张、P1 28 张。spec 车道里的 P1 是 1 张 epic(#18215)和 4 张 `pm:blocked`,没有能接的。复查:`GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?labels=priority:p1&state=open`。
2. **#19518 仍是 `pm:queue`,未被认领。** 复查：读 #19518 的标签与 assignee。
3. **仓内已有「picklist」的叫法。**
   - `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx:7`、`:68` 把下拉选项称为「picklist options」。
   - `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx:584` 写「Dropdown/picklist」。
   - 参考应用用 `_picklists.ts`,裁决记为 17 个使用点、3 个包。
   - `packages/spec/src` 里没有叫 `valueSet` 的类型或字段。
   - 复查:`git grep -n -i picklist origin/main -- content/docs`。

### Q1 选项与代价

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户看到的后果 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | 按本车道已放开的规则，现在开工 #19518(只做 spec 层) | 共享选项列表更早可用;#19519 运行时层与 objectui#10202 Studio 层仍在各自车道排队 |
| **B** | 维持 09-21 裁决，等全部产品 P0/P1 关闭 | 本车道不做这项;参考应用继续靠复制 TypeScript 常量(能用，不静默) |

业务直译:A = 先把「选项集」这个概念在协议里定下来，后面两层可以接着排;B = 这项功能整体晚一些。

### Q2 选项与代价

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户看到的后果 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | 叫 `picklist`:文件 `*.picklist.ts`,引用 `Field.select({ picklist: 'industry' })`,翻译 `picklists.<name>` | 与仓内文档和参考应用的现有叫法一致 |
| **B** | 叫 `valueSet`:文件 `*.valueSet.ts`,引用 `Field.select({ valueSet: 'industry' })` | 与 Salesforce 的 Global Value Set 叫法一致;仓内现有文档里「picklist options」的说法要另外统一 |

业务直译:A = 用客户和文档里已经在用的词;B = 用一个更抽象、今后也能套在非下拉字段上的词。

### 四轴(业务立场)

- **长远合理性:** 两年后的样子：共享选项列表是一等元数据，多个对象引用同一份。主流平台(本席未实测):Salesforce 叫 Global Value Set,字段类型叫 Picklist;Dataverse 叫全局 choice(旧称 option set);ServiceNow 叫 choice list。名字一旦发布就是永久接口，选与现有文档一致的名字，特例最少。
- **实际业务拉动:** 参考应用有 17 个使用点在复制同一批选项常量(裁决实测);外部客户需求未测。
- **防 AI 犯错:** 两个名字都能做到写错引用时响亮拒绝;差别在于 AI 生成代码时更可能写出哪个词。仓内文档已用「picklist」,AI 照文档写更不容易拼错。
- **创业阶段不扩散:** Q1 的 A 只开 spec 这一层，不连带开工运行时和 Studio。

### 推荐

- **Q1:A**,只开 spec 层。只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转：否。回退:B。置信缺口:「P0/P1 优先」放开后是否也覆盖一张卡上明写的时序，本席看不到你的本意，所以上交。
- **Q2:A(`picklist`)**。只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转：否。回退:B。置信缺口：主流平台的叫法并不统一，本席没有实测客户更熟哪个词。

### 裁后执行(维护者只裁方向)

- **Q1=A:** 本席按 #19518 的 Scope 认领并派发 spec 层，带上裁定的名字，走完整认领、达档复核和落地;#19519 与 objectui#10202 按原裁决在 #19518 落地后解锁。
- **Q1=B:** 本卡回到 `pm:queue`,#19518 保持原样。Q2 的名字照样记下，开工时直接用。
- 两题都由本席在本卡贴执行记录，并把 #19518 正文 Scope 第 1 条的「name to confirm」改为裁定的名字。

### 四棱

① 项目长远合理性：共享选项列表收掉「跨包复制 TypeScript 常量」这个特例;名字选与现有文档一致的一个。
② 实际业务拉动：参考应用 17 个使用点(裁决实测);外部需求未测。
③ 防 AI 犯错：命名引用写错即被拒，响亮;与文档一致的名字更少拼错。
④ 创业阶段不扩散：只开 spec 一层;新类型是永久义务，所以名字一次定准。
Prior rulings read: picklist, valueSet, global value set → 本卡 3 条裁决与指令评论(`5715762696`、`5755100805`、`5755653853`)以及 #19518 正文;ADR: ADR-0005(覆盖层，第 2 阶段才涉及);thread: 本卡 4 条评论。
推荐:Q1 A,Q2 A。只看①选 A / A;②③④ 是否翻转：否。置信缺口：见上。

Ruling: batch #251 item 3 · letter Q1 A · Q2 A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-30T05:39Z

Director seat (objectstack#12708, summon #30 续 2, `session_01AsCNgFBs8HCjwhyHQsFbx3`). Provenance: maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-30, replying 「同意」 to batch #251 as presented (this card as item 3, with #20281 and #18386); 「同意」 is to the director's recommendation in chat, which adopted the seat's decision request `5903510250` (Q1 A, Q2 A) after this seat's own reading: open P0 2 / P1 19 at 04:3xZ and none takeable in the `domain:spec` lane; #19518 `pm:queue`, p2, unclaimed; "picklist" in `content/docs` 9 hits and in the reference app's `_picklists.ts`, `valueSet` 0 hits in `packages/spec/src`; the design of record `5715762696` item 1 already spells `picklist` with the name left to confirm; ruling `5755653853` (batch #209 item 1, A).

**Ruled: Q1 A.** #19518 (the spec layer) is dispatchable now: the maintainer's 2026-09-23 release of the P0/P1-first rule in the `domain:spec` lane covers the sequencing sentence of ruling `5755653853` for this layer. #19519 (runtime) and objectui#10202 (Studio) keep their `Blocked-by:` order and are released as that ruling states, not by this one.

**Ruled: Q2 A — the kind is named `picklist`.** File pattern `*.picklist.ts`; the field reference `Field.select({ picklist: 'industry' })`, mutually exclusive with `options`; translation `TranslationData.picklists.<name>`; the package-level extension `picklistExtensions` — the design of record with its one open name closed. ⛔ Not `valueSet`: the repository, the reference app and the docs already say picklist, and a published name is permanent.

Readings recorded with the ruling:
- Long-run: a first-class shared option list, named as this ecosystem already speaks (Salesforce's field type is Picklist; its set is a Global Value Set; Dataverse says global choice; ServiceNow choice list — the names differ, the documented word here is one).
- Pull: 17 use sites in the reference app (measured on the earlier ruling); external demand unmeasured.
- AI-safety: a wrong reference is refused loudly under either name; the documented word is the one an AI writes correctly.
- Startup scope: the spec layer only.

Execution parameters (ruled in the same stroke):
- `domain:spec` seat 5 claims #19518 under its Scope with the ruled name, corrects Scope item 1 ("name to confirm") on that body, and runs the full claim, at-tier review (`Clause-②: yes`: a new metadata kind) and landing. The NORTH-STAR feature-map line and the two `records-forms` checklist items ride their own small Tier H docs PR, as ruling `5755653853` states.
- The per-organization overlay stays deferred to its own sub-issue on a measured customer requirement (ADR-0005, additive only).
- Confidence gap recorded: which word customers know better, unmeasured.

State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` on this parent (the coordination node; `priority:p2`, `domain:spec`, `area:records` stay); #19518 stays `pm:queue` and is takeable now; the Ruled line goes on the body in the same stroke; a pointer goes on #19518.
